text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for prompt-router feature 'smartfanout' -> new endpoint /v1/smartfanout at 2026-03-15T12:03:54Z. rollout_id=r-20260315-42. targeting 10% traffic. monitoring metrics. :rocket:

carla (sre): seeing a spike in 502/504 from the canary group, error rate ~18% over baseline in the first 4m. marking for immediate attention. @ben please confirm.

ben (eng-runtime): ack. pulling logs now. if this keeps climbing we should flip the feature flag 'experiment.smartfanout' off and abort the canary.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED: CANARY_FAILURE r-20260315-42 — prompt-routing smartfanout. Severity: Sev2. Channel: #incidents. Pager notified.

ben (eng-runtime): toggling feature flag -> experiment.smartfanout = OFF
response: {"status":"ok","flag":"experiment.smartfanout","value":false}

carla (sre): confirmed — traffic re-routed to stable prompt-router-v1 immediately. 5xx rate dropping toward baseline.

eva (support): 3 customer tickets flagged high latency/errors (Acadia, BishopHealth, LumaSearch). ETA for customer-facing note?

ben (eng-runtime): quick counts: ~3.2k failed requests in the 6m window, error payloads show upstream connection resets and 502s. no indication of PII in logs.

ben (eng-runtime): initiating hard rollback of canary replica set as well:
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/prompt-router-canary --to-revision=1
# watching pods: kubectl get pods -l app=prompt-router -w
```

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered for rollout_id=r-20260315-42 at 2026-03-15T12:06:42Z.

carla (sre): observing steady state after rollback. 5xx down to <0.5% of baseline. marking kill-switch applied and rollback complete. :white_check_mark:

ben (eng-runtime): feature flag off applied at 1769501302. canary replica set undone at 1769501365. All traffic on stable v1.

dmitri (pm): good work. please hold any re-enables until we have RCA and a compatibility test. add blocking task for release owner.

carla (sre): initial impact assessment: partial degradation for canary-routed customers only (10% traffic split). Estimated affected sessions ~0.02% of global traffic, but impacted a few paying customers due to routing affinity. No data exfiltration.

eva (support): drafting customer note: "We observed failures for a small percentage of requests during a canary test of an experimental prompt routing endpoint. Traffic has been reverted to the stable endpoint and we are investigating. No customer data was exposed." Will post to the 3 affected customers and keep them updated.

ben (eng-runtime): quick root-cause hypothesis: smartfanout's new request fanout logic rejected certain multi-part prompts leading to upstream connection resets (502). stack trace shows NPE in parsing path for payloads with empty metadata[].

carla (sre): tagging @infra-team and runtime for deeper dig. creating incident ticket with timeline. oncall handoff: I'm handing off monitoring to frank (oncall-next) in 30m. frank, please watch error budget and retry queues.

frank (oncall-next): taking over monitoring. will watch until 13:30 UTC and escalate if anything reappears.

incident-bot: Status update: CANARY_ABORTED, feature flag 'experiment.smartfanout' set to OFF, rollback complete. Severity reduced to Sev3 at 1769501789.

carla (sre): follow-up actions queued: 1) add unit + integration tests for smartfanout parsing 2) compatibility harness for prompt shapes 3) gating automation for canary => block re-enable until tests pass + signoff. assigning to ben + infra-team.

dmitri (pm): scheduling postmortem/retro for tomorrow. include customer impact notes and timeline.

carla (sre): closing thread here — incident contained, rollback and kill-switch successful. moving docs to postmortems board. thanks everyone for quick response. :bow:
